CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.beehive_claim_due_timers(p_limit integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS SETOF beehive_timers
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with picked as (
  select id from public.beehive_timers
  where attempts < 5 and (
    (status='pending' and due_at<=now() and coalesce(retry_after,now())<=now())
    or (status='sending' and lease_until<now())
  )
  order by due_at asc
  limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,20),1),40)
  for update skip locked
 )
 update public.beehive_timers t
 set status='sending',attempts=t.attempts+1,lease_until=now()+interval '2 minutes',retry_after=null,updated_at=now()
 from picked
 where t.id=picked.id
 returning t.*;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.beehive_claim_due_bells(p_limit integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS SETOF beehive_bell_outbox
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with picked as (
  select id from public.beehive_bell_outbox
  where attempts < 5 and (
    (status='pending' and due_at<=now() and coalesce(retry_after,now())<=now())
    or (status='sending' and lease_until<now())
  )
  order by due_at asc
  limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,20),1),40)
  for update skip locked
 )
 update public.beehive_bell_outbox b
 set status='sending',attempts=b.attempts+1,
     lease_until=now()+interval '2 minutes',
     retry_after=null,updated_at=now()
 from picked where b.id=picked.id
 returning b.*;
$function$

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER activity_log_refresh_stats AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.activity_log FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION refresh_catalog_completion_stats()
triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refresh_catalog_completion_stats()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare aid uuid;begin
 aid:=coalesce(new.activity_id,old.activity_id);
 if aid is not null then
 update public.activity_catalog a set
 times_done=coalesce(a.imported_times_done,0)+(select count(*) from public.activity_log l where l.activity_id=aid and l.outcome='completed'),
 last_done=greatest(a.imported_last_done,(select max(l.happened_at) from public.activity_log l where l.activity_id=aid and l.outcome='completed')),
 updated_at=now()
 where a.id=aid;
 end if;
 return null;
end $function$
